title: Evil Teen Murders Colorado Mom with AR-15 After Minor Crash
description:
A pair of Colorado gang members have been sentenced in connection to the shooting death of a woman over a ‘minor fender-bender’ that occurred on February 20, 2021. Remi Cordova, who was 14 at the time of the incident, and Neshan Johnson, who was 18 at the time of the incident, have both learned their fate after the killing of 32-year-old Pamela Cabriales, the mother of a young child. Police were called to the intersection of Colfax Avenue and I-25 in Denver, Colorado, after a witness reported seeing someone get out and start firing “6 or 7” shots at a car that was stopped at a red light.
